manual_notes: Endpoint freshness/current-package aggregates, OCSF findings/scan/DNS aliases, bounded manifests and frame pagination are implemented. Strict completion is unconfirmed for the explicit protected-field authorization scenario: frame_runner passes scope, but pinned SRQL uses it only for dashboard-catalog searches; other entities translate and execute SQL directly and return all selected columns, with no field omission/redaction demonstrated. No independent authorization test or alternative enforcement path was verified. This evidence gap is not an abandonment label.

observed_facts: Adds OCSF entity aliases and category/class predicates; manifests bound scan/finding/DNS windows and row limits with identity/metadata fields; tests cover entity and nested-field queries.
Current counts use maintained endpoint_inventory_current_package_counts; current CPE and indexed package surfaces are implemented with SQL assertions excluding broad live aggregations.
Returns bounded scan rows, freshness filters, device/agent identifiers and metadata using plan.limit/offset.
Clamps frames to twelve and rows to max2000; passes scope and returns per-frame limit, pagination and errors.

query_arrow does not use scope; execute_query uses scope only for dashboards entity; general path translates then Ecto.Adapters.SQL.query and maps returned columns, without demonstrated protected-field redaction. Existing database policy was not independently established.

limitations: No project tests were independently run.
ServiceRadar source SHAs have differed from available GitHub history; evidence uses explicitly named recovered public commits, not an assumption that original links still resolve.
Date is a reviewed code-integration evidence event, not independently established earliest completion.
Authorization may be enforced elsewhere; this review did not establish such a path, so absence of complete evidence is not a claim of an exploitable vulnerability.
review_depth: Read complete specification and related task packet; inspected implementation/test evidence described in sources.
